scope: Proves RawrXDCore.dll and the standalone ModelGenie executor produce bitwise-identical full-logit vectors for the same teacher-forced input. This is runtime equivalence, NOT reference parity with llama.cpp.

provenance.execution_mode: teacher-forced, greedy (sampling disabled), incremental KV decode
provenance.source_restoration_note: Source files were missing from the working tree and were restored from the pre-parity snapshot ModelGenieExecutor.cpp.pre_parity_packed_dot_001.bak. The restored build was re-verified: it reproduces the certified 65-position native logits BITWISE (65/65), and the saved DLL logits remain bitwise identical to it (65/65). An alternative copy at tmp_build_owns was tested and REJECTED: it produced 6 argmax differences (e.g. pos 1 185->1, pos 22 1218->9057) with cosine ~0.994-0.999. The executable hash therefore changed from 017B8487... to B0A0DA0F... as a consequence of rebuilding from the restored source.
provenance.executable_hash_note: MSVC embeds a build timestamp in the PE header, so the executable SHA-256 is NOT reproducible across rebuilds. Rebuilding the identical source produced three different hashes (017B8487..., B0A0DA0F..., DCC3583A...). The AUTHORITATIVE provenance anchor is therefore the source git blob hash plus the deterministic output-artifact hash, not the executable hash alone.

authoritative_provenance.note: Both native and DLL 65-position aggregate hashes are identical and stable across rebuilds.

repeatability.note: standalone, dll_run1, dll_run2 and dll_run3 each hash identically over the concatenated 65 positions

kv_state_note: KV-cache deep comparison at positions 0,1,19,20,32,64 was NOT performed in this run. The bitwise logit identity across 65 positions is strong indirect evidence of KV agreement (any K/V divergence would perturb logits), but direct tensor-level KV comparison remains open.
lifecycle_note: Create/load/execute/reset/reload/destroy lifecycle stress test was NOT performed in this run. Single-create/single-destroy lifecycle exercised only.
